wbAutoTooltip: White balance found from the photo
aboutWhat: A RAW photo editor. Argentum takes RapidRAW's application and moves darktable's colour science into it, one module at a time.
aboutWhy: The reason for the fork was narrow: RapidRAW's interface and speed are excellent, and its colour maths was a placeholder — its white balance was three fixed multipliers, with no Kelvin and no camera profile. RapidRAW 1.6.5 has a real white balance of its own now, and Argentum uses it; camera profiles, highlight recovery and the rest are still Argentum's.
roadmapDesc: Where Argentum is going. Nothing here is a commitment — it is the order the work is being done in.
knownIssuesDesc: What is broken today, and being worked on. Items marked inherited come from RapidRAW rather than from anything Argentum changed.
releasesDesc: What changed, and what it means for your photos. Versions with nothing visible to a user are not listed.
aboutMergeableDesc: A fork usually drifts until it can no longer take the original's updates, and then one person is maintaining a whole photo editor alone. Argentum is built not to. Its own code lives in its own files and reaches the rest of the application through a small, fixed set of connection points — sixteen lines, in twelve of RapidRAW's files.
aboutMergeableDesc2: That number is not allowed to grow with new features: the build fails if a change adds one. So RapidRAW's improvements — speed, tools, new camera support — keep arriving here, and the colour work happens on top of them rather than instead of them.
profileNoCamera: That profile does not say which camera it is for, so it will not match automatically.
gearCamerasDesc: Filled in as you open photos. Profiles you keep for each camera — choose one per photo in the Color panel. Argentum reads profiles but ships none; “Find one” asks RawTherapee, which publishes them.
gearNoCameras: No cameras yet. Open a photo and its body appears here.
gearLensesDesc: Lenses Argentum detects are added here automatically. Add one by hand for glass your camera does not report — old manual lenses, or adapted ones.
gearNoLenses: No lenses yet. They appear as photos are detected.
gearNotPublished: No published profile for this camera. You can still import one you have.
rawToneHelp: Choose the RAW tone rendering; your curves remain after it
recoveryHelp: Rebuilds a colour channel that blew out from the two that survived.
thresholdHint: Hold Ctrl while dragging to see what is about to clip
tiffDepth8Help: Smaller file. The same precision as a JPEG — right for a delivery, not for re-editing.
tiffDepth16Help: For re-editing elsewhere. 1024 tonal levels in every stop of exposure.
superResolutionSubtitle: Restore undoes lens softness at the photo's size; Enlarge makes it 2x or 4x bigger. Either or both, saved as one new file.
restoreHelp: Undoes lens softness - a lens used wide open - at the photo's own size, before Capture sharpening. Runs once per photo: about a minute on a graphics card for a 32 MP frame.
restoreMaskHelp: Where Restore applies. Higher: only the sharpest edges and texture. Lower: further into fur, and into grain. At the default a soft background is left as it was; at 0 the whole photo is restored.
restoreShowMask: Show the mask: white is where Restore applies
restoreMaskView: Mask: white is where Restore applies, black is left as it was
restoreChoose: Choose Restore, an enlargement, or both, then click Enhance
enlargeOffNeedsRestore: Turn Restore on to save without enlarging
modelsDesc: Each AI feature downloads the model it needs the first time you use it, and keeps it on this computer. Delete one to get the space back: it downloads again the next time you use that feature.
modelsMaskSet: The four mask models arrive together. Using any AI mask downloads whichever of them is missing.
modelsOther: {size} of that is other files in the models folder, such as an unfinished download.
modelsWaiting: Will be removed when Argentum next starts
modelsAtNextStart: Argentum is using this right now, so it can't be deleted yet. It will be removed the next time Argentum starts.
panelsDesc: Text size sets how large the writing in the panels is. Row spacing sets how much room each slider gets. Long names are shortened; point at one to read it in full.
toneMapperOnlyDefault: Only with Rendering: Default. The other renderings set the tones themselves.
sharpenZoomHint: Judge at 100%: at fit-to-screen, capture sharpening is too fine to show.
sharpenShowMaskHelp: Show the mask: white is sharpened, black is left alone. Ctrl while dragging a slider here shows it too.
sharpenCaptureHelp: Automatic. Undoes the softness every RAW has off the sensor (RawTherapee).
sharpenAutoRadiusHelp: Read from the RAW: how soft its sharpest edge is, as RawTherapee measures it
sharpenAutoContrastHelp: Found from the flattest part of the photo, so smooth areas and noise are left alone
sharpenLegacy: This photo also has RapidRAW’s old sharpening at {n}.
sharpenEnabledHelp: The whole photo's sharpening on or off. Flip it to compare before and after. A mask's own Sharpen is not affected.
sharpenMaskSameHelp: Protect the same areas as Capture
sharpenLocalHint: Right sharpens, left softens. This mask's own Radius, Mask and Threshold are under More.
layoutHistoryEmpty: Open a photo to see its history.
mwFavouritesHint: Right-click a folder and pin it to keep it here.
mwChooseFolder: Choose a folder on the left
mwPathTip: Click to type or paste a folder path (Alt+D)
mwGear: Settings, AI models, My Gear, About (Ctrl+,)
mwInfoTip: ISO, aperture, shutter and focal length. Click for all the photo's details (I)
mwNoPhoto: No photo selected. The tools work on the photo you pick.
mwReadOnlyMany: To change all {count}, use Looks or paste settings.
mwOpenToUse: Open a photo (Enter) to use this tool.
mwEmptyTitle: Pick a folder on the left
mwEmptyNote: Every disk is under This computer. Nothing is imported or copied.
mwEmptyPaste: Or paste a path in the bar above
mwNoDisks: No disk could be listed. Paste a folder's path in the bar above to open it.
mwNavDock: Put back in the left column
looksImportFailed: Some files could not be imported.
looksHintPhoto: Hover to preview on the photo, click to apply.
looksNoFavourites: Star a look to keep it here.
looksSaveTip: Save the photo's settings as a preset or a LUT file
looksExportFailed: The presets could not be exported.
looksSelectFirst: Select photos in the grid first.
looksHintGrid: Click a look to put it on the selected photos. Open one (Enter) to preview.
snapNew: New snapshot of the photo as it is now (Ctrl+N)
snapEmpty: + keeps the photo as it is now.
snapGridNote: Open the photo (Enter) to restore one.
settingsKelvinDesc: Temperature in kelvin (K) and Tint as absolute values, instead of a change from as shot. A photo with no as-shot white balance stays as a change.
